candidates.change_summary: Change return value from true to false.
Replace the require check requiring at least one target with a check requiring an empty target array, causing valid calls with targets to revert and empty calls to proceed.
Replace the require check requiring at least one target with a check requiring at least two targets, causing calls with one target to revert.
Delete the require check requiring at least one target, allowing calls with an empty target array to complete instead of reverting.
Change the return statement to return false instead of true, so completed calls report the opposite boolean result.
Insert an early return false after the require check, causing all calls with at least one target to return false without performing the transfer calls.
Change the selector from transferFrom to transfer.
Replace the encoded call arguments to swap from with _tos[i] in the call data.
Replace the encoded value argument with a hardcoded zero.
Remove the require statement checking _tos length.
Always return false instead of true.
Delete the return true statement so the function does not explicitly return, changing its return value.
